==Quest Start==
'''Note:''' For the older versions of the rewards for these quest (prior to the 7/24/11 patch) see [[Plane of Sky Quests (Old)]].

Talk to Drakis Bloodcaster in the [[Plane of Sky]].

You say, 'hail Drakis Bloodcaster'
:''Drakis Bloodcaster says 'Greetings, dark one. Are you ready to begin? ''
You say, 'I am ready to begin'
:''Drakis Bloodcaster says 'Then choose, necromancer.  Do you wish to be tested by Dugaas or Jzil? ''

Drakis Bloodcaster will not respond to "I choose ______" unless you are a necromancer, but any class can complete the quests once the NPC is spawned.

= Jzil Gsix =

You say, 'I choose jzil'
:''Drakis Bloodcaster says 'Take this tome and read it.  When you are finished, return it to me and I will summon Jzil. ''
:''Drakis Bloodcaster says 'Farewell. ''
:''Jzil GSix says 'Walk the path of blood and feel thy power. ''
You say, 'hail Jzil GSix'
:''Jzil GSix says 'Ah, so you have come to be tested.  Many fine things can be your reward.  There are three tests I can administer. Will you take the test of flight, power, or mind?  I also am in search of a item you might have gotten from me and are willing to trade back. ''
You say, 'I am willing to trade'
:''Jzil GSix says 'I am searching for a Rotted Griffon-Hide Wrist Guard so I can replace them with the Wrist Guard I've just mastered creating. '' 

== Necromancer Test of Flight ==

Jzil GSix says 'So, you wish to start upon the test of flight? So be it.  You must return to me a verdant tessera, an ebon shard,
 and a griffon's beak to reap your rewards.  May the darkness guide your steps. 

'''Reward:''' {{:Bloody Griffon-Hide Wrist Guard}}

| [[Griffon's Beak]] || [[Gorgalosk]] || Island 3 Boss
|}

 Jzil Gsix says, 'Yesss? You do well, Okayge. Take thisss sssmall token to show my ressspect for you.'

Jzil GSix says 'The test of power it is.  Prove yourself worthy of power and bring me a silver disk, spiroc feathers, and a black silk cape.  Only then will you know true power.

== Necromancer Test of Mind ==

Jzil GSix says 'The test of mind it shall be.  You must return to me, from this place of air and mist, a rugous globe, some djinni blood, and fine cloth raiment.  Then, and only then, you shall have the reward you deserve! 

'''Reward:''' {{:Bloodsoaked Raiment}}

|-

= Dugaas Helpyre =

You say, 'I wish to be tested by Dugaas'
:''Drakis Bloodcaster says 'Take this book and read it then.  When you are finished, hand it back to me and I will summon the vile Dugaas. ''
:''Drakis Bloodcaster says 'Farewell. ''
:''Dugaas Helpyre says 'Walk the path of blood and feel thy power. ''
You say, 'hail Dugaas Helpyre'
:''Dugaas Helpyre says 'So, you dare be seen in my presence.  Truly a brave fool you are.  You come seeking fame and glory here, do you?  Well, fool, perhaps you will get what you seek.  Will you take the test of the heart, the hands, or the finger?  Of course we could also discuss a little trade I'm interested in making. ''
You say, 'I am interested in trade'
:''Dugaas Helpyre says 'I'm searching for the Band of Screaming Winds that I had given out a long time ago.  I've recently fashioned an improved version and would like to see the people that have already put so much effort into helping me get their just reward.''

Dugaas Helpyre says 'So the heart it shall be.  Bring me, foolish one, an imp statuette, an obsidian amulet, and a pulsating ruby.  Perhaps then you shall find your reward. 

'''Reward:''' {{:Sphinx Heart Amulet}}

== Necromancer Test of Finger ==

Dugaas Helpyre says 'The finger.  Needed for nearly every casting you shall ever hope to produce, it truly is the most powerful tool of creation.  Should you bring me a white spiroc feather, a nebulous ring, and the Ring of Veeshan, I shall reward you with power you can only now begin to comprehend. 

'''Reward:''' {{:Band of Wailing Winds}}
